answer: Glacier-ridge vertex admission auction: each epoch issues only 100 identity slots, one per vertex on a glacier ridge. Applicants bid; the top 100 win and lock a 70-credit bond, every bid public. A sybil attacker must outbid honest applicants per slot: first fake 40, k-th 40+0.5(k-1), 1000th 539.5, so 1,000 fakes pay 289,750 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-bid ring fails: each bid binds to its vertex key. An honest agent pays one bid near 40.
